bf5c5f63ad2a0da6ce4839bc28e15fe6daaf5920: San Cassiano offers 130 km of well-marked runs — a medium-sized ski area that is ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. With a summit at 2778 m and a village at 1537 m, snow cover at San Cassiano is generally reliable from January to the end of March. The budget for a stay at San Cassiano is clearly high: €80 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants that are among the most expensive in the Alps. It is the price of excellence — but you should be aware of it before you go. In short: San Cassiano lives up to its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most skiers without disappointing.
